children: Odyssey Marine Exploration entered into an amendment to its Note Purchase Agreement with American Ocean Minerals to enhance interim financing ahead of their proposed merger. The amendment, signed Sep 8, 2026, provides for a new $500,000 Initial Note to be purchased on Sep 9 and allows continued subsequent advances under both Initial and Pre-Closing Notes, subject to $5.0 million caps each (or higher at AOM’s discretion). The secured notes bear 8.0% interest, PIK quarterly, and mature on the earlier of Apr 8, 2027, or merger closing, with an 11.0% default rate. Obligations are secured by substantially all of Odyssey’s assets.
: Amendment to secured note purchase agreement for promissory notes
: Until earlier of Apr 08 2027 or merger closing
: Bolster liquidity ahead of proposed merger
